name: meg-website
description: Meg Van Deusen's Astro website and Sanity Studio

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix apps/studio
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix apps/web && npm run check --prefix apps/studio && npm run check --prefix apps/backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/web && npm test --prefix apps/studio && npm run test:hosting && npm test --prefix apps/backend
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:build --prefix apps/web && npm run check:redirects
